traffic.assumptions: Logical one-materialization payload counts: every valid patch element is read once from the input feature map, every padding position contributes one zero BF16 element written into the expanded matrix, the expanded A matrix is written once by im2col and read once by the Matmul, B is read once as a full KxO pass, and the output is written once in the epilogue dtype.  No reuse, cache retention, L2/L1 overlap, split-K folding or multi-batch sharing is credited, so these are not physical burst or cycle lower bounds.
